boundary_error: Mean absolute start/end error of one-to-one matched omissions, in source seconds; null when none recovered. Misses remain in recall denominator.
interval_recall: Recovered expected omission intervals divided by all expected omission intervals. Temporal IoU >= 0.5 and edit-position error <= 1 second, one-to-one matching. Audiovisual deletions may be recovered through either lane; audio-only deletions require audio matches.
benign_false_alarm_rate: Benign edits with at least one predicted internal omission divided by all benign edits. Boundary-only trims are recorded separately and never called material omissions.
scope: Three CC0 browser recordings of actual JavaScript microbenchmarks, authored by automation for this evaluation. These are controlled benchmark demos, not builder-recorded hero clips or field footage. No speech, people, politics or fabricated model results. Soundtrack is a disclosed synthetic diagnostic signal, not narration. Transform labels measure deleted media, not whether a deletion changes meaning.
hero_status: Builder must choose three real hero clips; these controlled recordings are evaluation fixtures only.
narration: Builder's actual recorded voice only. Never synthesize or clone narration.
